translations.en: I shall use the last of my magic to heal the entire party.
As for getting back to town, I can rely on the sorcerer."
"Where has everyone gone?
I turned around, and there was no one there.
Only darkness stretched before me."
"That person read this. Ahaha."
"I did it! At last, I have conquered this labyrinth!
Without anyone's help! All by myself! My magic is spent, but who cares!
I, the ver-"
...Beyond that point, dried blackish liquid
made the writing impossible to read.
Something like a child's scribbling covered the floor.
"Play          with
me."
Something was written on the wall in feeble letters.
"It's dark. I'm scared."
A stone broke loose and fell from overhead.
If it had struck you, you would not have escaped unscathed.
As you breathed a sigh of relief,
you heard something like a click of the tongue beside your ear.
Something was written on the floor in feeble letters.
"It hurts. I'm scared."
A light sound came from somewhere, like a ball bouncing.
Could a child be playing in a place like this?
Could someone be here besides your party?
You could hear high-pitched laughter.
You could hear something.
A dragging, slithering sound, as though someone were walking
while trailing soaking wet clothes behind them.
Your foot caught in the mud,
and you fell.
A sticky, lukewarm liquid
soaked into your clothes.
There was a strange smell.
Rather than a stench, it was a familiar smell,
something you had smelled somewhere before.
You had smelled the same thing after the last battle.
"What is this place? It's scary as hell."
"Oh, crap. I'm changing classes to a priest or cleric."

translations.en: Something lay on the ground.
It was a teddy bear.
It was terribly battered, with an arm torn off
and one eye barely hanging on by a thread.
Something lay at your feet.
It seemed to be a small child's shoe.
It was terribly worn and filthy.
Something like an old letter lay on the ground.
"I'm going to the holiday house with Daddy soon.
I hope I get to play lots with all kinds of children."
In a photograph tucked inside, a little girl
was smiling happily.
Someone seemed to be knocking on a door.
Something lay on the floor.
It appeared to be a family photograph.
A girl in the middle was smiling happily.
Something was written on the floor.
"I'm going to get farther, even if it kills me."
You could hear faint little footsteps.
When you stopped, the footsteps seemed to stop too.
You could hear singing from somewhere.
It was a beautiful voice.
But who could be singing so deep inside this labyrinth?
There was a pleasant smell.
It smelled like something simmering.
The light cast a shadow.
What could be casting that shadow?
Something cold touched the back of your neck.
You touched it, but there was nothing there.
It did not seem to have been a drop of water.
Something was written on the wall.
Was that red crayon?
"Won't you play with me?"
You could hear someone sobbing somewhere.
The moment you listened closely, a girl's voice whispered in your ear.
"Why are you leaving me alone?"
You tripped over something.
Looking back, you saw something like a knife, rusted dark red,
lying on the ground.
Letters had been scratched into the wall with something hard.
